hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes amounts using its own bonding curve (CurveLib), deposits input tokens into Euler vaults, withdraws output tokens to the pool manager, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta—bypassing Uniswap concentrated liquidity entirely. It also blocks native LP add-liquidity and donations to prevent unproductive positions.
